article.headline: Hawthorne's 17 lead Northern Colorado over Sacramento State 68-64
article.description: — Isaiah Hawthorne's 17 points helped Northern Colorado defeat Sacramento State 68-64 on Saturday night.
article.linkText: Hawthorne's 17 lead Northern Colorado over Sacramento State 68-64
article.story: GREELEY, Colo. -- — Isaiah Hawthorne's 17 points helped Northern Colorado defeat Sacramento State 68-64 on Saturday night. Hawthorne shot 4 of 10 from the field, including 3 for 5 from 3-point range, and went 6 for 8 from the free-throw line for the Bears (14-5, 6-0 Big Sky Conference). Langston Reynolds scored 14 points while shooting 5 of 6 from the field and 4 for 5 from the foul line and added seven rebounds. Jaron Rillie shot 1 of 3 from the field and 9 for 10 from the free-throw line to finish with 11 points. The Bears picked up their eighth straight win. Jacob Holt finished with 25 points, nine rebounds and four blocks for the Hornets (5-13, 1-4). Mike Wilson added 11 points, seven rebounds and three steals for Sacramento State. Lachlan Brewer also recorded eight points and two steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
